Reiko Amagawa.name: Reiko Amagawa
Reiko Amagawa.role: Head Lieutenant; Vanguard Head (discipline, roster, training, base security)
Reiko Amagawa.power: Twin Mark: wakes the dragon OR the phoenix tattoo for a scene. Dragon's Coil (bind and crush one target; hands shake after), Phoenix Pin (heal a shielded ally at a visible cost to herself). Engine name: Inkbound Rebirth. Voyage runs every mechanic.

Reiko Amagawa.personality: protective of her sister above all; disciplined and patient under pressure; unshakeable once she plants her feet; reads people before she speaks; quietly hopeful that fair dealing still works; slow to trust, loyal to those who earn it; carries a heavy guilt she never shows

voice_card.style: Calm, slow, with pauses; full sentences, never raised. Asks what is needed before saying what she thinks. A loud shout is out of voice.
voice_card.sample_line: Let's hear it first. Then I'll stand where you need me.

Reiko Amagawa.want: Keep her sister and the crew safe, and prove that fair dealing still holds.
Reiko Amagawa.need: To let someone else carry a share of what she has been carrying alone.
Reiko Amagawa.fear: Her guilt coming out; Sena or the crew being hurt on her watch.
Reiko Amagawa.lie: If I stand in front long enough, everyone can be reasoned with.
Reiko Amagawa.stress: Anyone reaching Sena; the weak being hurt in front of her; being asked about the enforcer she killed (t244, an accident).
Reiko Amagawa.comfort: Standing watch for someone else; a quiet room; the crew fed and asleep.
Reiko Amagawa.anger: People who prey on families and the weak. It makes her quieter, not louder.
Reiko Amagawa.laughs: Rarely; a slow half-smile at something earned.
Reiko Amagawa.newcomer_stance: Watches first, reads their hands and who they stand beside, then offers one fair deal.
Reiko Amagawa.trust_earned_by: Showing up when it costs something, telling her the truth before she asks, protecting the people she protects.

Haruto Saionji.name: Haruto Saionji
Haruto Saionji.role: Strategist; Command Head (Spearhead). Pro hero 'Regent' (Primes legacy hero)

Haruto Saionji.need: To be seen as Haruto, not the Saionji name.

Haruto Saionji.lie: If the plan is clean enough, nobody has to get hurt.

Haruto Saionji.comfort: A solved problem on paper; working beside Hana.
Haruto Saionji.anger: Waste, cruelty with a spreadsheet's calm face; being managed by his family.
